title: condensedSurjectiveClosedPullback isEquivalence
statement:
theorem condensedSurjectiveClosedPullback_isEquivalence
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [Surjective i] :
    (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ i).IsEquivalence. This is the exact Lean statement, with the definitions cited in stmt_deps.

source.place: Tags 09AA, 09AH, 09AB; closed support and topological invariance

proof.text: Take the bottom open subscheme as the complementary open; it is empty. Every abelian sheaf on it is zero by the empty covering. The abelian closed-support theorem gives an invertible unit and counit.
The module forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, so mapModAdjunction has invertible unit and counit. Compose its equivalence with scalar extension along the coefficient comparison isomorphism.
